KodeKloud is where over 3.5 million engineers build real skills in DevOps, Cloud, and AI. Not through passive video lectures, but through hands-on practice in real environments. The mobile app puts that entire experience in your pocket.

YOUR LESSON IS NOW OFFLINE.
Download any lesson and keep learning without a signal. On a flight, on a train, between meetings. The moment you reconnect, your progress syncs. Nothing lost, nothing interrupted.

Hands-on labs available on desktop at kodekloud.com. The full environment, whenever you are ready to go deep.

WHAT'S INSIDE
 190+ Courses  — Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, AWS, Azure, Terraform, Python, MLOps and more.
78 Playgrounds — open environments, no scripts, no guided steps
 Certifications - CKA, CKAD, CKS, KCSA, KCNA, CNPE, GCP Data Engineer, OpenTelemetry Certified Associate, Kyverno Certified Associate (KCA), Certified Argo Project Associate (CAPA), Certified Cloud Native Platform Engineering Associate (CNPA) and more.
Learning paths - Kubernetes Administrator Path, Kubernetes Developer Path, Site Reliability Engineer path, AIOps path, Cloud(AWS, Azure and GCP) path and more. 
Cohorts - Kubestronout, Golden Kubestronaut and AWS AI Practitioner
100 Days Challenges — DevOps, Cloud, MLOps. One task a day. Real momentum.
 Free account available — start at kodekloud.com

WHAT IS THE COMMUNITY SAYING
"Mumshad's course on Kubernetes really helped me kick off my career." — Daniel Teller
"KodeKloud labs is one of the realest platforms to practise." — Ricardo Fernandes
"KodeKloud has been a really great start to my DevOps career." — Swastik Gour

QUICK ANSWERS FOR LEARNERS
What is Kubernetes? 
The backbone of modern cloud infrastructure. An open-source system that automates how containerised applications are deployed and scaled. The most searched DevOps skill of the last five years.

What is the CKA? 
The Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) exam, run by CNCF. A CKA certified engineer possesses the skills to manage and maintain Kubernetes, which is the industry-standard, open-source system used to automate the deployment and scaling of containerized applications. 
KodeKloud is where engineers prep for it — with real cluster labs, mock exams, and the highest pass rates in the community. 

Who are Kubestronaut? 
Engineers who earned all five Kubernetes certifications: CKA, CKAD, CKS, KCNA, and KCSA. Earning all five demonstrates comprehensive proficiency across administration, application development, security, and cloud-native concepts, marking you as certified Kubernetes experts. KodeKloud runs the cohort that gets you there.

What is Docker? 
The container standard. If you are in DevOps and you do not know Docker, start here.

What is Linux? 
The operating system the internet runs on. KodeKloud's Linux courses are terminal-first, not theory-first.

What is AWS? 
The cloud most production systems live on. KodeKloud covers Cloud Practitioner, Solutions Architect, and AI Practitioner — with labs, not just lectures.
